title: Oozie Wilted Menemen Eggplant Omelette
description: A winey, tender, energizing Turkish dish featuring Cajun spices and a vegetarian-friendly ovo-vegetarian combination. Perfect for breakfast.
instructions: Peel and dice the eggplant into small cubes.
Finely chop the onion and mince the garlic cloves.
Mix the diced eggplant with red wine vinegar, olive oil, salt, black pepper, and Cajun seasoning mix in a bowl.
Heat the pan, add olive oil, then sauté the onion until translucent.
Add minced garlic to the pan, stir for 30 seconds, then incorporate the eggplant mixture.
Sauté all ingredients together until the eggplant is tender and most of the liquid has evaporated.
Transfer the cooked mixture into a hot skillet, top with fresh thyme sprigs.
Fold the omelette gently to create an even menemen texture and allow it to cook for another 30 seconds.
